# Pull Request Template

## Title

`<type>: <short summary>` (e.g `docs: add setup steps to README`)

## Linked ticket

Closes #\<number> / Board card: \<link or name>

## What does this PR do?
<!-- 1–3 sentences in plain words. -->

## Why is it needed?
<!-- The reason or business value. -->

## What changed?

-
-

## How was it checked?
<!-- Steps you took, or "Read through for typos and broken links". -->

## Screenshots / evidence (if relevant)
<!-- Before / after. -->

## Author checklist

- □ Branch name follows the policy.
- □ Change is small and focused.
- □ I re-read my own changes.
- □ Docs updated if needed.
- □ No secrets or personal data included.
- □ Definition of Done is met.

## Reviewer notes
<!-- Anything you want the reviewer to look at closely? -->

## Reviewer checklist

- □ Does what the ticket asks.
- □ Clear and readable.
- □ No privacy or security concerns.
- □ Feedback labelled `blocking` / `suggestion` / `nit`.
- □ All conversations resolved before merge.
